findings: AMENDMENT-W1-07-01 (applied): the Imperial race row summed to 11; PER +4 -> +5.

AMENDMENT-W1-07-02 (applied): RG-COURT was +2/+2 against the item's own prose and method 2; RI-CHR02 §4a row C is 24 not 28; §4a's aggregate Saxhleel-Dunmer 15.3 is not in the matrix (recomputed 11.75, sum 141/12) so method 3's >=12 is restated at RI-DLG04's >=8; RI-CHR01 §6.4's 105 is 80 by its own parenthesis.
Corpus gap kept, not papered over: RI-PRG03 ships Polearms and no race or named class raises it. Reachable via custom + questionnaire; declared as GAP-W1-07-polearms.

The questionnaire and custom routes were producing class_family 'custom' — a seventh family that put every custom start OUTSIDE RI-CHR01 §5's 540 grid. sheet.familyOfSkills() now classifies a five-skill shape into one of the six by overlap with the named roster.
reachableClasses() was O(4^10 x sort19); it is now a five-slot insertion plus a bitmask class table, 284 ms for 1,048,576 routes.

RI-CHR01 §6.1's grep-for-"class" prohibition is now a false-positive generator (road class, water class, hazard class). The audit asserts GATE semantics — a class key inside requires/forbids/conditions/gate, or requires_class/class_min — and prints the naive count with its per-file breakdown.
next_step: none — piece complete. A successor should re-run `node tools/analysis/creation-audit.mjs` and `node tools/analysis/ar3-encounter-test.mjs` before changing anything under game/data/progression/**.
notes_for_successor: The arithmetic modules are pure and total on purpose: the audit tool IMPORTS game/src/character/*.js rather than reimplementing, so a critic measures the shipped composition. Do not fork them. KNOWN-GAPS.json is the only place an assertion may be excused, and an excuse that stops being true fails the run as STALE.
